Deportes • ⑫
• Four more will punch their tickets into the next round as GLORY & RISE search for the baddest featherweight on the planet in this year long tournament. Meanwhile on the RISE side of the bracket, Japan’s Yutaro Asahi (17-9, 4 KO) clashes with Spain’s Eduardo Catalin (17-3-1) and top Japanese prospect Yura Kono (15-1, 7 KO) goes up against China’s Dexiang Kong (35-10). In addition to the Last Featherweight Standing matchups, Shiro Matsumoto (53-17-4, 18 KO) defends his RISE bantamweight title against top challenger Masahi Kumura (24-7, 12 KO) and Australian KO artists Chadd Collins (64-18-2, 32) defends his RISE super lightweight championship against the great Kento Haraguchi (25-4-1, 14 KO).

programme.title: Backpack
programme.desc:
Estilo de vida • ⑦
• Bali, un escondite tropical, logra ser un paraíso para los buscadores de aventuras, un santuario espiritual, un paraíso para los amantes de la comida y el retiro de un entusiasta de la naturaleza, todo al mismo tiempo. Esto es algo que Hannah Jackson descubre por sí misma mientras explora los templos de Bali, como el templo de Ulan Danu, prueba mariscos deliciosos y ultrafrescos, disfruta de algunas actividades de aventura como un paseo por el mar y visita un criadero de tortugas.
• rakuten

programme.title: Great World Hotels
programme.desc:
Estilo de vida • ⑦
• Un viaje a Maldivas es como un viaje a un gran paraíso de aguas azules. Una villa con piso, que ofrece vistas claras del océano turquesa y la exquisita vida marina bajo sus pies, realza esta experiencia para Kim durante su visita. Se mima aún más con un tratamiento de spa bajo el agua y una botella de vino de una bodega subterránea, que es como una cueva del tesoro para los conocedores del vino de todo el mundo.
• rakuten

programme.title: Off The Grid
programme.desc:
Estilo de vida • ⑦
• Al comenzar su viaje por la Ruta Atlántica Salvaje desde Dublín, Alex planea conducir hasta el final y hace su primera parada en "Cliffs of Moher". Luego se detiene en el pueblo de Kildare y comprende la cultura irlandesa. Visita el Centro de Arte Claddagh. Además, su siguiente parada es el Castillo de Ashford, que ahora es una propiedad de lujo de 5 estrellas y luego la Escuela de Falcony de Irlanda. Más adelante en su viaje, visita a Croagh Patrick en Westport y luego, al finalizar el episodio, recorre 60 kilómetros en bicicleta hasta Mulranny.
• rakuten

programme.title: Xplore Oman
programme.desc:
Estilo de vida • ⑦
• En una visita a Mascate, la capital de Omán, Elisha Kriis se encuentra boquiabierta ante la magnificencia de la Gran Mezquita del Sultán Qaboos, que domina el horizonte de la ciudad. Mientras se pierde en los tesoros de Oriente Medio en el famoso Muttrah Souq, comienza a experimentar los clásicos encantos árabes de Omán.
• rakuten

programme.title: 10 Days Korea
programme.desc:
Estilo de vida • ⑦
• Seúl, la capital de Corea del Sur, es una ciudad dinámica que forja sin miedo un camino hacia el futuro preservando fielmente sus raíces. Andrew Maciver, adicto a los viajes, prueba las delicias locales en los Pojangmachas, carritos de comida callejera típicos coreanos, de los animados mercados de Myeongdong. También ve las atracciones icónicas de la ciudad, como el templo Jogyesa, Daedongmun, que es la puerta este de la ciudad, y el palacio Gyeongbokgung, que alguna vez sirvió como sede de uno de los imperios más grandes del Asia medieval.
• rakuten

programme.title: Watts On the Grill
programme.desc:
Cocina y comida • ⑦
• In this bacon loving episode, Chef Spencer delivers a tasty Bacon Weave Turkey Breast, which gets injected with beer and spices before being wrapped up in its cozy bacon blanket and sent off to the grill! Next up? A Peameal Bacon Roast with Rosti. This heavy hunk of back bacon gets smoked to flavourful perfection while Chef Watts makes the crispiest golden-fried-to-perfection potato pancake. Then, Spencer whips up a charry, grilled, super decadent, bacon-wrapped and bacon stuffed cheeseburger. Spencer isn't finished with bacon yet! For his final recipe, Spencer stuffs an apple with decadent crispy morsels stuffed along with savoury caramelized onions and melty cheddar cheese.
• rakuten

programme.title: Watts On the Grill
programme.desc:
Cocina y comida • ⑦
• This episode kicks off with Spencer's tasty Grilled Caesar Salad. He skillfully piles of char-grilled romaine lettuce wedges and sourdough croutons are topped with tangy dressing, crispy pancetta, and shards of a homemade parmesan tuile. For his next recipe, Spencer whips up Grilled Zucchini Boats that filled with fresh ingredients including orzo pasta, summer veggies, and herbs. Chef Watts loves a good steak and his Grilled Cauliflower Steak is not one to be passed up! Dusted in Middle Eastern Spices, flame roasted and served with chili-spiked, Yemeni 'Skhug' hot sauce and pomegranate seeds. Finally, Spencer steams tender artichokes, stuffing these flowers with breadcrumbs and stretchy-melty cheese, and finishes this delicious dish on the grill.
• rakuten

programme.title: Watts On the Grill
programme.desc:
Cocina y comida • ⑦
• The most liked post on any grill-master's social feed is 'meat on a stick' - and Chef Spencer's Turkish-style chicken kabob is worth every click! He marinates thick juicy chicken morsels in yogurt and spices, and then grills these flavourful skewers to a charry perfection. Next up is the creative 'Tornado Potato' which re- invents grilled potatoes with a wild presentation and a trio of toppings. Spencer then assembles Char Siu Sliders on tiny party- ready buns. Stuffed with a soy, honey and umami-packed hoisin lacquered slow-and-low grilled pork belly, these tasty little sliders will have your taste buds tingling. For his final recipe, Spencer whips up toasted crispy roti cups; topping them with plump and majestic grilled prawns and stuffed with a layered spicy chickpea curry. Now that's a BBQ party!
• rakuten

programme.title: Watts On the Grill
programme.desc:
Cocina y comida • ⑦
• Chef Spencer starts this spicy barbeque episode with flavours from Thailand with a Bok Choy with a Ginger Chili Sauce. Powerful bird's eye chilies are packed into a sweet and spicy sauce and served over tasty grilled bok choy. Spencer then introduces us to Calabrian chilies, mashed into a spice paste and rubbed on butterflied chicken that then gets grilled to flame-kissed perfection. Next, Spencer gives fresh calamari some heat with Korean chilies that add their distinctive heat and flavour before grilling this scrumptious recipe and serving it over a comforting bed of rice and peas. Finally, Spencer prepares Seekh Kabobs, made with ground lamb spiked with punchy dried Kashmiri chilies and a blend of fresh hot peppers.

programme.title: Watts On the Grill
programme.desc:
Cocina y comida • ⑦
• First stop on Chef Spencer's Spanish flavour tour? Habanero Char-Grilled Octopus - warmed up with punchy chilies and balanced with a sweet and tangy sherry vinaigrette. Next, Spencer stuffs whole sea bass with citrus and herbs, gives it the grill treatment and then tops it with olive oil blistered cherry tomatoes. The rotisserie does the heavy lifting for Mr. Watts' whole roast chicken - spiked with bright Spanish flavours like Spanish chilies and smoked paprika, slow cooked and served extra juicy. Finally, Spencer prepares a classic Spanish recipe: Paella. Loaded saffron rice, piled high with chorizo, veggies, and shellfish. Of course, Spencer's Paella is made in the Spanish tradition; outside, over the fire, on a beautiful sunny day!

programme.title: Watts On the Grill
programme.desc:
Cocina y comida • ⑦
• It's all about beautiful butter in this episode of Watts on the Grill! First up, entertaining host Spencer fires tosses clams in velvety butter, zesty garlic and earthy spices to make his Clams with Garlic Paprika Butter. All the butter chicken flavours we love are infused in the marinade, before getting crisped up on the fiery grill - the result is both classic and completely new! Scallops are next, grilled and served with a mouth-watering caper-raisin butter. For his final recipe; Chef Watts prepares a rich and juicy grilled Rib Steak topped with a decadent port wine compound butter. Oh, what a butter-loving day!

• We've all cooked with salt. But what about ON salt. That's right, chef Spencer Watts blows our minds with his seared scallops that are cooked on a Himalayan pink salt block. His next recipe uses a quick cure with Hawaiian black lava salt on swordfish steaks, then tops them with a gorgeous and refreshing grilled fruit salsa. Then, Spencer gets creative with Cured Duck Legs with Scallions, using a salt cure to intensify the flavours of duck leg before it's cooked slow and low, then glazed with maple and soy. After cooking on salt, curing with salt, the only thing left is to cook INSIDE salt - Spencer's Salt Crusted Prime Rib is a game changer, flavourful, bone-in beef that he seasons with a big, bold Dijon mustard, rosemary and horseradish rub before encasing it completely in a classic salt crust and sending it to the grill.

Chocolate is the not-so-secret ingredient in Spencer's Grilled Chicken Molé. He grills the chicken legs smothered in the sweet-spicy-salty-nutty-creamy-chocolatey sauce, then finishes it by cooking it slow and low. Next, dark chocolate cocoa powder is in both the rub and the sauce for Chef Watts' favourite pork rib recipe - Cocoa-rubbed Baby Back Ribs. For his final recipe, Spencer takes it to a sweet level with his Chocolate pizza made with chocolate ganache, grilled cherries, with barbeque- caramelized white chocolate crumble over the top.

programme.title: Los Últimos Dragones Urbanos
programme.desc:
Documental • ⑦
• En la ciudad de Oviedo, al norte de España, habitan varias poblaciones muy singulares de salamandras, muchas de las cuales han permanecido aisladas desde la fundación de la ciudad en el siglo VIII. En este documental se narra su historia, las leyendas que rodean a este animal desde la antigüedad, así como las singularidades de estas poblaciones que han conseguido sobrevivir en la ciudad sin cursos de agua, elemento esencial en la reproducción de la mayoría de anfibios.

programme.desc:
Asian • ⑦

Su objetivo es mostrar a los televidentes la riqueza cultural de China y el mundo hispanohablante, elevar el conocimiento de la cultura china en los países de habla hispana y establecer una plataforma de diálogo entre ambas partes. Se trata de un programa mensual de 30 minutos de duración que comenzó a emitirse en agosto de 2016. Está compuesto de tres segmentos que destacan por su diversidad temática.
